title: Scene
description:
Top-level declarative scene description (`docs/scene-format.md`, version 1).

Every frontend (JSON files, the CLI, the desktop/web viewer, and the Rust builder API)
produces and consumes this type.

filters.description:
Named derived datasets produced by visualization filters. Keys must be lowercase
`snake_case` and unique across `sources` and `filters`.

output.description: Headless image output configuration (required by `tetraglass render`, optional for interactive viewing).

sources.description:
Named input datasets read from mesh files. Keys must be lowercase `snake_case`
and unique across `sources` and `filters`.

version.description: Schema version number (must be `1` for v1 scenes).

view.description: Viewport configuration: visible representations, camera, lighting, background and annotations.

bottom.description: Color at the bottom edge of the viewport.

top.description: Color at the top edge of the viewport.

BackgroundSpec.description:
Viewport background specification (`view.background`): a solid [`ColorSpec`] (default: `"white"`)
or a vertical [`BackgroundGradient`].

azimuth.description: Horizontal orbit angle in degrees around the focal point, applied after fitting (default: `0.0`).

elevation.description: Vertical elevation angle in degrees around the focal point, applied after fitting (default: `0.0`).

fit.description:
Target bounds to frame: `"all"` (default) or the name of a specific source or filter.
Ignored when [`Self::position`] is explicitly provided.

focal_point.description: Explicit world-space focal point `[x, y, z]`. Defaults to the fitted bounds center when omitted.

position.description: Explicit world-space camera eye position `[x, y, z]`. Overrides `fit`, angles, and `zoom`.

roll.description: Roll angle in degrees around the viewing direction, applied after fitting (default: `0.0`).

view_angle.description: Vertical field-of-view angle in degrees for perspective projection (default: `30.0`).

view_up.description: Explicit world-space up vector `[x, y, z]`.

zoom.description: Zoom factor applied after fitting; values greater than `1.0` move closer (default: `1.0`).

ClipKeep.description: Which half-space to keep relative to a clip plane's outward normal (`filters.<name>.keep`).

oneOf.description: Keep the half-space in the direction of the plane normal (`(p - origin) · normal >= 0`).
Keep the half-space opposite to the plane normal (`(p - origin) · normal <= 0`).
Cut tetrahedra along the clip plane via the shared marching-tetrahedra kernel (`D-006`).
Keep whole original source cells that overlap the kept half-space.

ColorSpec.description:
A color specification: either a CSS color name (such as `"white"` or `"lightgray"`)
or a linear `[r, g, b]` triple with components in `0.0..=1.0`.

anyOf.description: Explicit `[r, g, b]` color with each channel in `0.0..=1.0`.

position.description: Placement of the colorbar in the viewport (default: `"right"`).

title.description: Optional title label displayed on the colorbar (defaults to the array name when omitted).

ColorbarPosition.description: Placement of a colorbar legend inside the viewport.

oneOf.description: Vertical colorbar on the right edge of the viewport (default).
Vertical colorbar on the left edge of the viewport.
Horizontal colorbar along the bottom edge of the viewport.
Horizontal colorbar along the top edge of the viewport.

anyOf.description: Enabled colorbar with custom title or position.

oneOf.description: Perceptually uniform sequential blue-green-yellow colormap (default).
Perceptually uniform, color-vision-deficiency-friendly blue-yellow colormap.
Diverging blue-white-red colormap (`"cool_warm"`).
High-contrast rainbow-like sequential colormap (`"turbo"`).
Linear black-to-white grayscale ramp (`"grayscale"`).

save_blend.description: Optional `.blend` output path to save the constructed Blender scene alongside rendering.

Filter.description:
Visualization filter definition (`filters.<name>`).

Internally tagged by `"type"`. Milestone M1 implements `"surface"`, M2 adds `"slice"`,
`"contour"`, `"clip"`, and `"threshold"`, and M4 adds `"streamlines"`, `"glyphs"`, and `"resample"`.

oneOf.description: Extracts the external boundary surface of the input dataset.

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

oneOf.description: Cuts the input volume dataset with a plane (`origin` defaults to the center of input bounds).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

normal.description: Outward plane normal `[nx, ny, nz]` (must be non-zero; normalized automatically).

origin.description: Optional point `[x, y, z]` on the slice plane. Defaults to the center of the input dataset bounds when omitted.

oneOf.description: Extracts one or more isosurfaces from a continuous point attribute array (`"contour"`).

field.description: Point array reference (`"<array>"` or `"<array>:<component>"`) to contour.

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

values.description: Non-empty list of finite isovalues to extract.

oneOf.description: Clips the input volume dataset with a plane, keeping one side in `"exact"` or `"crinkle"` mode (`"clip"`).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

keep.description: Which half-space to keep relative to `normal` (default: `"front"`).

mode.description: Clipping mode: `"exact"` (default) or `"crinkle"` (keeps whole original cells).

normal.description: Outward plane normal `[nx, ny, nz]` (must be non-zero; normalized automatically).

origin.description: Optional point `[x, y, z]` on the clip plane. Defaults to the center of the input dataset bounds when omitted.

oneOf.description: Keeps cells of the input volume dataset whose attribute value is within `[min, max]` (`"threshold"`).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

max.description: Optional inclusive upper bound (omit for a one-sided `>= min` threshold).

min.description: Optional inclusive lower bound (omit for a one-sided `<= max` threshold).

oneOf.description: Integrates streamlines through a 3-component vector field on the input volume dataset (`"streamlines"`).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

max_length.description: Optional maximum arc length per integration direction (`> 0.0`). Defaults to `4.0 * bounds.diagonal()`.

step_size.description: Optional initial / fixed integration step size (`> 0.0`). Defaults to `0.01 * bounds.diagonal()`.

tube_radius.description:
Optional tube radius in world units (`> 0.0`) used when displayed with `"tubes"` or `"surface"` style.
Defaults to `0.012 * bounds.diagonal()`.

vectors.description: Vector attribute array reference (`"[point:|cell:]<array>"`, 3 components) to integrate.

oneOf.description: Instantiates oriented and scaled 3D glyphs (`"arrow"`, `"cone"`, or `"sphere"`) from a 3-component vector field (`"glyphs"`).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

scale_by.description: Glyph sizing mode: `"magnitude"` (default) or a fixed positive world-space size.

scale_factor.description: Optional positive multiplier applied to the glyph size (`> 0.0`).

vectors.description: Vector attribute array reference (`"[point:|cell:]<array>"`, 3 components) to orient and scale glyphs.

oneOf.description: Resamples the input volume dataset onto a regular 3D grid `[nx, ny, nz]` for `"volume"` ray-marching (`"resample"`).

dimensions.description: Sample grid resolution `[nx, ny, nz]` along the X, Y, and Z axes (each `>= 2`).

input.description: Name of the input source or filter.

from.description: Starting time step or time value.

to.description: Ending time step or time value.

GlyphScaleBySpec.description: Glyph scaling specification (`"magnitude"` or a fixed positive size in world units).

anyOf.description: Uniform world-space base size (`> 0.0`) for all glyphs.

oneOf.description: Scale glyph size proportionally to the local vector magnitude `|v|` (`"magnitude"`).
Cylindrical shaft with a conical tip oriented along the vector (default).
Circular cone with base at the sample point and apex oriented along the vector.
UV sphere centered at the sample point.
Headlight plus key and fill lights (default).
Single camera-attached headlight.

Output.description: Headless render output settings (`output` section in `docs/scene-format.md`).

image.description: Output PNG path relative to the scene file (can be overridden by `tetraglass render -o`).

msaa.description: Multisample anti-aliasing sample count (`1` or `4`, default: `4`).

size.description: Image width and height in pixels `[width, height]` (default: `[1200, 800]`).

time.description: Time step selector for transient datasets (default: `"first"`).

oneOf.description: Perspective projection with foreshortening (default).
Parallel orthographic projection.
Fit to the minimum and maximum of the current time step (`"auto"`).
Fit to the minimum and maximum across all time steps in a series (`"auto_all_steps"`).

RangeSpec.description: Scalar value range specification for colormap mapping (`"auto"`, `"auto_all_steps"`, or `[min, max]`).

oneOf.description: Built-in wgpu rasterizer (default).
Headless Blender Cycles path tracer (M3).

Representation.description: Visual representation of a source or filter in `view.show`.

center.description: Optional reference value mapped to the midpoint of a diverging colormap.

color.description: Solid surface color used when [`Self::color_by`] is omitted (default: `"lightgray"`).

color_by.description:
Optional array reference (`"[point:|cell:]<array>[:<component>]"`) used for scalar coloring.
When omitted, the representation uses the solid [`Self::color`].

edge_color.description: Wireframe and element-edge color for `"surface_with_edges"` and `"wireframe"` (default: `"black"`).

input.description: Name of the source or filter dataset to display.

log_scale.description: Whether to map positive scalar values logarithmically (default: `false`).

opacity.description: Surface opacity in `0.0..=1.0` (default: `1.0`). Values below `1.0` use order-independent transparency (M3).

point_size.description: Point diameter in pixels for the `"points"` style (default: `3.0`).

range.description: Scalar range mapped across the colormap (default: `"auto"`).

transfer_function.description:
Optional piecewise-linear opacity transfer function `[[t, alpha], ...]` (`t` and `alpha` in `0.0..=1.0`,
sorted by `t`) for `"volume"` representations. When omitted, a linear ramp `[[0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 1.0]]` is used.

oneOf.description: Shaded surface (external faces of volume meshes).
Shaded surface overlaid with element edges.
Element edges only.
Mesh vertices rendered as screen-space points.
Polyline rendering for streamlines (M4).
Shaded tube rendering for streamlines (M4).
Direct volume rendering of a resampled grid (M4).

Source.description: A named input dataset read from a mesh file (`sources.<name>`).

file.description: Path to the mesh file, resolved relative to the scene file (`.vtu`, `.vtk`, `.pvd`, `.msh`).

format.description: Optional explicit mesh format override. When omitted, the format is inferred from the file extension.

linearize_level.description: Reference-space subdivision level for higher-order cells (default: `2`, used from M2 onward).

SourceFormat.description: Supported mesh file format identifiers in a scene [`Source`].

oneOf.description: VTK XML UnstructuredGrid (`.vtu`).
Legacy VTK UnstructuredGrid (`.vtk`).
ParaView XML time-series collection (`.pvd`).
Gmsh MSH 2.2 or 4.1 mesh (`.msh`).
Integrate forward along `+v(x)` (default).
Integrate backward along `-v(x)`.
Integrate both backward and forward from each seed and join into a single polyline.
Adaptive Dormand-Prince RK4(5) integrator (default).
Fixed-step classical 4th-order Runge-Kutta integrator.

count.description: Number of seed points (`>= 1`) uniformly spaced along the segment.

from.description: Start point `[x, y, z]` of the seed segment.

to.description: End point `[x, y, z]` of the seed segment.

StreamlinePlaneSeedSpec.description: Rectangular plane-grid seed generator (`{ "plane": { "origin": [...], "normal": [...], "extent": [w, h], "count": [nu, nv] } }`).

count.description: Grid resolution `[nu, nv]` along the two in-plane axes (`nu >= 1`, `nv >= 1`).

extent.description: Optional width and height `[w, h]` of the seed grid on the plane. Defaults to `[0.5 * diag, 0.5 * diag]` when omitted.

normal.description: Plane normal `[nx, ny, nz]` (must be non-zero; normalized automatically).

origin.description: Optional center `[x, y, z]` of the seed plane. Defaults to the center of the input dataset bounds when omitted.

oneOf.description: A single seed point `[x, y, z]`.
An explicit list of seed points `[[x, y, z], ...]`.
`count` seed points uniformly spaced along the segment from `from` to `to`.
A `count[0] * count[1]` rectangular grid of seed points on a plane.
First time step in the time series (default).
Last time step in the time series.

TimeSelector.description: Selector for choosing a time step in a transient dataset (`"first"`, `"last"`, `{ "step": n }`, or a time value).

TimeStepIndex.description: Explicit zero-based time-step index selector (`{ "step": n }`).

step.description: Zero-based index of the time step in the series.

View.description: Viewport specification (`view`): representations to draw, camera, lighting, background and annotations.

axes.description: Whether to draw the orientation axes triad in the corner of the viewport (default: `true`).

background.description: Viewport background color or vertical gradient (default: `"white"`).

camera.description: Camera framing, orientation, zoom and projection settings.

show.description: Ordered list of dataset representations to display in the viewport.

title.description: Optional title text drawn at the top of the image.
